official_text: Income Tax Department. Intimation under section 143(1) for Assessment Year 2025-26. Tax credit differs from the credit claimed in the return. TDS credit allowed Rs. 35,000; TDS credit claimed Rs. 50,000.

discrepancies.title: TDS credit mismatch
discrepancies.description: The tax credit allowed in processing is lower than the TDS credit claimed in the return.
